supported_claims: Synthetic browser capture and recovery flows exercised chunk persistence, reload recovery, storage quota handling, interrupted upload retry, device track disconnection, permission denial/revocation, server-prefix recovery and final sealing.
A simulated capture clock exercised five-minute progress and automatic stop at the configured thirty-minute limit; this was not a thirty-minute wall-clock recording.
Final local upload retry resumed committed offsets without retransmitting already committed bytes.
limitations: Fake browser microphone and public mock WAV data do not validate a physical microphone, actual device unplug behavior, OS permission dialogs, or real-time capture over thirty minutes.
The adapter is scripted non-ASR; no model inference or accuracy test was performed.
This is software recovery evidence, not clinician validation or clinical release authorization.
